analogy.rationale: HIV protease inhibitors are not expressed targets in these cell lines and their annotated targets are drug-metabolizing CYP enzymes, so the transcriptional response should be weak; the closest analogs are other classes sharing CYP inhibition or antiviral/antiinfective pharmacology rather than a shared downstream program.
